final: WITH project_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(1.0 * s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate FROM scans AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_rate FROM project_rates) SELECT r.arcref, r.fundflux, r.avg_rate, r.avg_rate - o.avg_rate FROM project_rates AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_rate IS NOT NULL AND r.avg_rate > o.avg_rate ORDER BY r.avg_rate - o.avg_rate DESC LIMIT 10
